item.title: Cessna veers off San Jose runway after landing gear collapse
item.description: A Cessna aircraft veered off the runway at a San Jose airport Friday morning after its right landing gear collapsed during touchdown.

item.title: 49ers and NFL Mexico launch student flag football program

item.title: Rattled San Ramon residents attend town hall over quakes
item.description: Hundreds of San Ramon residents attended a town hall Friday to talk about recent swarms of earthquakes that have rattled the region. item.title: Video shows 72-year-old’s arrest in Brentwood a week before her death
item.description: Brentwood police released body and in-car camera footage of officers arresting 72-year-old Yolanda Ramirez during a September family dispute; she died a week later.

item.title: San Francisco Superior Court strike ends, clerks to return to work
item.description: After striking for more than one day for the first time ever, the San Francisco Superior Court's clerks say they've reached a tentative agreement to end their strike. The agreement was reached Friday afternoon, officials with Service Employees International Union Local 1021 said. The clerks were demanding better wages, training and staffing.
